City Centre

King's Theatre

A grand Edwardian theatre on Bath Street, the King’s is Glasgow’s home for touring West End musicals, big comedy names, and large-scale drama. With over 1,700 seats across stalls and three balconies, it’s where Glasgow goes for a big night out — and it hosts the city’s legendary annual pantomime every Christmas.
